preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The lengths of strings S and A must be between 1 and 100,000.
The total lengths of all strings S across all test cases must not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(S_prime) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid S' exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid S'.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcde' for c in S_prime)
postconditions.description: All characters in the constructed S' must be from the set {a, b, c, d, e}.

postconditions.expression: not any(A[i] in S_prime[j] for i in range(M) for j in range(N))
postconditions.description: A cannot be a subsequence of S'.
